prerequisites: Strong writing skills (essential for the exam)

learning_outcomes.text: Gain an initiation to Antiquity, the study of texts and images, and an introduction to anthropology and sociology.
Produce a relevant and in-depth commentary on documents (text and/or image) related to myths.
Reflect on the nature of a myth.
Understand how a myth is both the product of collective imagination and the expression of a society.

syllabus_topics: Heroes and heroines from Antiquity to the present day
Narratives of origins and the beginnings of humanity
assessment_rules: The exam will not consist of recounting myths, but of producing a pertinent reflection on them, applying the notions and methods seen in class. Students must be able to produce a relevant and in-depth commentary on one or more documents (text and/or image) related to one or more myths.
